basics.name: Kenzan Hase
basics.label: iOS Engineer
basics.summary: I am an iOS engineer with about 15 years in software, including 10 years focused on iOS.

work.name: Wolt
work.summary: iOS engineer on the consumer app at a Helsinki-based company connecting customers, merchants, and couriers for delivery of food, groceries, retail, and more. Swift, iOS.
highlights: Implemented the city-status module on the discovery homepage, surfacing late-night closures or slower delivery when busy.
Implemented the address-entry flow for Japan, using postcode lookup.

Owned a large-scale renewal of the iOS store page. With cross-functional teammates, covered the many cases where the header's metadata layout differs by country, regulation, and content, and made it stable. Translated motion specifications into scroll-driven motion: the image fades, the logo shrinks, and the title moves from centered to leading and crossfades. The shorter header leaves at least one item visible.

Implemented Google Consent Mode and cross-app marketing-consent sync, including its documentation. Separately, handed ownership from the former Onboarding team to the Privacy team with added documentation and handover sessions, leaving the new iOS owner with clear, continuous ownership of this compliance-sensitive work at Wolt's scale.

Automated the onboarding regression cases with Maestro, covering Facebook, Google, Apple, Magic link, SMS, WhatsApp, and resend flows, with no dedicated Onboarding team. They run in the regression pipeline, cutting manual testing and speeding up delivery.
Added European Accessibility Act support for search, discovery, and address entry.

Led the iOS category page from scratch: one page per level of the product's category and sub-category hierarchy. Shipped advanced filter animations, an expanding grid, and performance work, and aligned iOS, Android, Web, and Backend on telemetry, response formats, and UI.
Built an experimental iOS frontend for an AI grocery-assistant chatbot. Fast proofs of concept, prototypes, and trials judged feasibility.

work.name: 株式会社InTrip
work.summary: Freelance iOS engineer on a Zen practice and sound meditation app. Swift / iOS.
highlights: Implemented new features such as My Page and a Zen diary.
Strengthened automated coverage of app behavior and UI with unit and snapshot tests.
Restructured the billing and in-app purchase flow.

work.name: 週末養蜂
work.summary: Freelance backend developer for a Japanese beekeepers' organization that sells equipment and runs Q&A, e-commerce, and community sites. NestJS / TypeScript.
highlights: Migrated the backend of the beekeepers' Q&A site from a legacy stack to a modern one ([38qa.net](https://38qa.net)).
Wrote up the migration: [A service renewal of backend built upon AWS Lambda](https://kenzan8000.org/blog/a-service-renewal-of-backend-built-upon-aws-lambda/).

work.name: ISI-Dentsu of America, Inc.
work.summary: Designed and developed proofs of concept and prototypes, ran client trials to assess feasibility, and researched business opportunities with local tech startups for a Japanese technical consultancy. Swift, Objective-C, iOS, Ruby on Rails, Vue.js, Python, Android.
highlights: Developed the backend for an AI robot that supports simple conversation. ([konel.jp](https://konel.jp/works/ai-kabira/))
Developed a travel-spot media site focused on photography. ([docoico.world](https://www.docoico.world))
Developed the backend and iOS app for a weekend event-planner prototype for families.
Developed Facebook Messenger and LINE chatbot prototypes for lounge spaces worldwide.
Developed an iOS app prototype that maps air-pollution data from an air-quality monitoring IoT device.
Conducted a feasibility study of a ride-hailing platform and mobile SDK for Japanese clients.
Conducted a feasibility study of a customer-support chatbot for Japanese clients.
Conducted a feasibility study of IoT smart glasses and their SDK.

work.name: 週末養蜂
work.summary: Freelance frontend developer for the same beekeepers' organization. React / TypeScript.
highlights: Developed the frontend for a beekeeper friend-search map. ([38qa.net/friend-map](https://38qa.net/friend-map/))
Developed a Medium-style rich text editor for 38qa.net.
Developed a simple chat and Facebook Messenger-style widget for 38qa.net.
Developed the frontend for a public chat widget on 38qa.net.

work.name: 株式会社ミライセルフ
work.summary: Freelance iOS engineer for a service that assesses cultural fit between companies and job applicants. Swift / iOS.
highlights: Developed an iOS prototype of an aptitude test for applicants and companies.

work.name: NexSeed, Inc.

highlights: Helped students launch more than 15 apps on the App Store.

work.name: CyberAgent
work.summary: Worked in the social media department. Developed two iOS apps from scratch, supervised and contributed to three more, contributed to the Ameba iOS SDK, and advised a cooking SNS project on adopting it. Objective-C / iOS.
highlights: Built an iOS app from scratch for a cooking SNS where users edit and share food photo diaries, on a cross-functional team. ([Pecolly](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pecolly-cooking-community/id544605228))

Built an iOS app from scratch for an SNS focused on sharing funny pictures and jokes, on a 5-person cross-functional team. ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/2miaode-xiaoeruapuri-ameba/id603484445))
Developed an iOS app for organizing social clubs online, and mentored another iOS engineer.
Developed an iOS app for a Twitter-like SNS, and mentored another iOS engineer.
Developed an iOS virtual-pet game and the in-game web pages.

work.name: PONOS Corporation
work.summary: Built mobile games from scratch with cross-functional teams for NTT Docomo, SoftBank, the App Store, and Google Play. Released four games. Java, C, Objective-C++, iOS, Android, OpenGL.
highlights: Developed iOS and Android action games focused on intuitive controls and tense, high-energy gameplay. ([Mr. Oops](http://www.ponos.co.jp/iphone/en/mroops.htm))
Developed an iOS strategy game in which players defend their territory and resources by blocking enemy attackers. ([Ballistik](http://www.ponos.co.jp/iphone/en/ballistik.htm))
Developed mobile action and strategy games featuring battles between armed planets, with a focus on well-balanced difficulty. ([Battle Planet](http://www.ponos.co.jp/taisenbaka/battle_planet.htm))
Developed a mobile shooting game that simulates a shooting gallery at a Japanese festival. ([Syateki](http://www.ponos.co.jp/taisenbaka/syateki.htm))
